messages:
Maya (People Ops): short follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: promos, timing, and appeals. posting brief clarifications.

Claire (IC3): are part-timers eligible for promo this cycle? one of ours is 0.6 FTE.

Ibrahim (Comp): yes. managers should normalize impact to FTE in the packet and note it explicitly. calibration panel will evaluate scope relative to FTE.

Jon (Eng Manager): when are manager packets due?

Maya (People Ops): manager packets due May 8 EOD PT. Calibration panels May 15-16. Final approvals by May 22. Appeals window 14 days after manager convo.

Claire (IC3): appeal process — can ICs add docs after manager convo?

Maya (People Ops): yes, you have 14 days to submit additional evidence via the appeal form. committee = People Ops + 2 senior managers + comp. target turnaround 10 business days.

Jon (Eng Manager): will managers get comp/headcount preview before final sign-off?

Ibrahim (Comp): yes — an estimated comp/headcount impact snapshot will be sent after calibration and before final approvals.

Maya (People Ops): thanks all. will upload checklist and templates to Notion and schedule office hours. DM us for urgent exceptions.
